news.title: Apple is Now the Top-Performing Magnificent 7 Stock in 2026. Here’s why it’s Beating NVIDIA, Tesla, and Amazon
news.summary: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) has emerged as the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock of 2026, outperforming NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), and Tesla (TSLA). But what's driving Apple's surprising rally while other AI stocks struggle? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St.'s Eric Bleeker examines why Apple shares have surged more than 27% in 2026, even as concerns about artificial intelligence spending are weighing on some of the market's biggest technology companies. While competitors are committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI data centers, Apple is taking a different approach. Its strategy emphasizes on-device artificial intelligence, privacy, and integrating AI directly into its ecosystem, avoiding much of the enormous infrastructure spending burden facing its rivals. Eric breaks down Apple's latest earnings, its massive share repurchase program, and why investors are increasingly rewarding the company's capital-efficient AI strategy. He also compares the Magnificent Seven's performance in 2026 against their remarkable returns since the beginning of 2023, revealing a very different picture of the AI investment boom. Has Apple become the market's ultimate AI safe-haven stock? And could its strategy continue outperforming NVIDIA and the rest of Big Tech?
news.title_zh: Apple 現為 2026 表現最佳的「宏偉 7」股票。為何能擊敗 NVIDIA、Tesla 與 Amazon
news.summary_zh: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) 已成為 2026 表現最好的科技七巨頭股票，跑贏 NVIDIA (NVDA)、Microsoft (MSFT)、Amazon (AMZN)、Alphabet (GOOGL)、Meta Platforms (META) 和 Tesla (TSLA)。但什麼推動了 Apple 令人驚訝的反彈，而其他 AI 股票卻在掙扎？在這一集中，24/7 Wall St. 的 Eric Bleeker 分析了為什麼 Apple 股價在 2026 飆升超過 27%，即使對人工智慧支出的擔憂正拖累市場上一些最大的科技公司。而競爭對手正投入數千億美元建設 AI 資料中心，Apple 採取了不同策略。其策略強調端側人工智慧、隱私，並將 AI 直接整合進其生態系，避免了競爭對手面臨的龐大基礎建設支出負擔。Eric 剖析了 Apple 最新財報、其大規模股票回購計畫，以及為什麼投資者越來越青睞該公司資本效率高的 AI 策略。他還比較了科技七巨頭在 2026 的表現，對比自 2023 以來的驚人回報，揭示了 AI 投資熱潮截然不同的畫面。Apple 是否已成為市場的終極 AI 避險股票？其策略能否持續跑贏 NVIDIA 和其他大型科技股？

news.title: The Next Stock Market Crash Could Start With Just 3 Companies
news.summary: Just three companies now account for approximately 21% of the S&P 500's total market capitalization. NVIDIA (NVDA), Apple (AAPL), and Microsoft (MSFT) have become so dominant that their performance could determine the direction of the entire stock market. But what happens if these technology giants stumble? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St. co-founder Doug McIntyre and senior writer Lee Jackson discuss the extraordinary concentration of the S&P 500 and why millions of investors may be taking on more risk than they realize. Much of today's market enthusiasm is driven by artificial intelligence. Companies like NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet (GOOGL), Amazon (AMZN), and Meta Platforms (META) have benefited from enormous expectations for AI growth. But Doug and Lee identify several potential threats to that optimism. They explore how cheaper open-source AI models could challenge industry leaders, why opposition to AI data center construction threatens expansion plans, and how growing electricity demand is driving renewed interest in nuclear power. Most importantly, they discuss what could happen to popular index funds like the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) if the market's largest technology stocks suffer a major sell-off. They also examine whether equal-weight S&P 500 funds could provide investors with better diversification. Is your S&P 500 investment more vulnerable than you think?
news.title_zh: 下一場股市崩盤可能僅由 3 家公司引發
news.summary_zh: 目前僅三家公司佔標普 500 總市值約 21%。輝達 (NVDA)、蘋果 (AAPL) 和微軟 (MSFT) 已變得如此主導，其表現可能決定整個股市走向。但若這些科技巨頭跌倒會怎樣？在這一集中，24/7 Wall St. 聯合創辦人 Doug McIntyre 和資深撰稿人 Lee Jackson 討論標普 500 的異常集中度，以及為何數百萬投資人可能承擔比預期更多風險。當前市場熱情很大程度由人工智慧驅動。輝達、微軟、Alphabet (GOOGL)、亞馬遜 (AMZN) 和 Meta Platforms (META) 等公司受惠於對 AI 成長的龐大預期。但 Doug 和 Lee 指出幾項對該樂觀情緒的潛在威脅。他們探討較便宜的開源 AI 模型如何挑戰業界領導者、為何反對 AI 資料中心建設威脅擴張計畫、以及不斷增長的電力需求如何推動核能重獲關注。最重要的是，他們討論若市場最大型科技股遭遇大規模拋售，熱門指數基金如 SPDR 標普 500 ETF (SPY) 會發生什麼情況。他們也檢視等權重標普 500 基金是否能為投資人提供更好分散化。您的標普 500 投資是否比您想像中更脆弱？

news.title: Meta, Tesla and Netflix Q3 Updates Coming This Week
news.summary: Tech earnings season is back (yes, I know it feels like it never ends). This time, we’ve got a slight twist: Meta Platforms has broken with the pack and is reporting its September-quarter earnings on Wednesday, a week ahead of its big tech counterparts, Google, Microsoft and Amazon. (Apple is even later, on Nov. 2.) By reporting earlier than the others, Meta ensures it will grab more of the spotlight, for better or worse. Until last week’s market sell-off, Meta had been riding a wave of enthusiasm on Wall Street, thanks to chatter about its Muse personal agent and recently released Muse Wonder AI models. Things changed last week, particularly on Friday, as renewed jitters about the AI expansion tanked most tech stocks. Given Meta’s gargantuan spending on AI development, this week’s update will provide a new test of investor sentiment toward Meta shares.

Given Meta’s gargantuan spending on AI development, this week’s update will provide a new test of investor sentiment toward Meta shares.

news.title: Neocloud Shakeout Looms, and Nvidia Has a Lot to Lose
news.summary: How many young AI cloud providers can the market, and Nvidia, support? That’s one of the big questions after a week in which investors worried about the data center buildout and the risks that its unproven participants, known as neoclouds, are taking. Those risks include loading up on debt (CoreWeave) or trying to go public without much of a track record (Firmus and Nscale). Firmus abruptly pulled its public offering last week while shares of CoreWeave and its smaller rivals fell around 20%. The concerns even hit bigger AI cloud providers like Oracle. Data center and neocloud executives told me there’s a limit to the number of AI cloud providers that can exist, even if Nvidia provides many of them with investment or backstops.
news.title_zh: Neocloud 洗牌迫在眉睫，Nvidia 損失慘重
news.summary_zh: 市場和 Nvidia 能支撐多少年輕 AI 雲端供應商？這是投資人擔憂資料中心建設及其未經驗證的參與者（稱為 neoclouds）所承擔風險後，一週內浮現的重大問題之一。這些風險包括舉債度高（CoreWeave）或在缺乏實績下嘗試公開發行（Firmus 和 Nscale）。Firmus 上週突然撤回公開發行，而 CoreWeave 及其較小競爭對手的股價下跌約 20%。憂慮甚至波及 Oracle 等較大型 AI 雲端供應商。資料中心和 neocloud 高管告訴我，即使 Nvidia 為其中許多提供投資或擔保，能存在的 AI 雲端供應商數量仍有上限。

items.title: Neocloud Shakeout Looms, and Nvidia Has a Lot to Lose
items.summary: How many young AI cloud providers can the market, and Nvidia, support? That’s one of the big questions after a week in which investors worried about the data center buildout and the risks that its unproven participants, known as neoclouds, are taking. Those risks include loading up on debt (CoreWeave) or trying to go public without much of a track record (Firmus and Nscale). Firmus abruptly pulled its public offering last week while shares of CoreWeave and its smaller rivals fell around 20%. The concerns even hit bigger AI cloud providers like Oracle. Data center and neocloud executives told me there’s a limit to the number of AI cloud providers that can exist, even if Nvidia provides many of them with investment or backstops.

news.title: Meta, Tesla and Netflix Q3 Updates Coming This Week
news.summary: Tech earnings season is back (yes, I know it feels like it never ends). This time, we’ve got a slight twist: Meta Platforms has broken with the pack and is reporting its September-quarter earnings on Wednesday, a week ahead of its big tech counterparts, Google, Microsoft and Amazon. (Apple is even later, on Nov. 2.) By reporting earlier than the others, Meta ensures it will grab more of the spotlight, for better or worse. Until last week’s market sell-off, Meta had been riding a wave of enthusiasm on Wall Street, thanks to chatter about its Muse personal agent and recently released Muse Wonder AI models. Things changed last week, particularly on Friday, as renewed jitters about the AI expansion tanked most tech stocks. Given Meta’s gargantuan spending on AI development, this week’s update will provide a new test of investor sentiment toward Meta shares.

news.title: Meta, Tesla and Netflix Q3 Updates Coming This Week
news.summary: Tech earnings season is back (yes, I know it feels like it never ends). This time, we’ve got a slight twist: Meta Platforms has broken with the pack and is reporting its September-quarter earnings on Wednesday, a week ahead of its big tech counterparts, Google, Microsoft and Amazon. (Apple is even later, on Nov. 2.) By reporting earlier than the others, Meta ensures it will grab more of the spotlight, for better or worse. Until last week’s market sell-off, Meta had been riding a wave of enthusiasm on Wall Street, thanks to chatter about its Muse personal agent and recently released Muse Wonder AI models. Things changed last week, particularly on Friday, as renewed jitters about the AI expansion tanked most tech stocks. Given Meta’s gargantuan spending on AI development, this week’s update will provide a new test of investor sentiment toward Meta shares.

news.title: Apple is Now the Top-Performing Magnificent 7 Stock in 2026. Here’s why it’s Beating NVIDIA, Tesla, and Amazon
news.summary: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) has emerged as the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock of 2026, outperforming NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), and Tesla (TSLA). But what's driving Apple's surprising rally while other AI stocks struggle? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St.'s Eric Bleeker examines why Apple shares have surged more than 27% in 2026, even as concerns about artificial intelligence spending are weighing on some of the market's biggest technology companies. While competitors are committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI data centers, Apple is taking a different approach. Its strategy emphasizes on-device artificial intelligence, privacy, and integrating AI directly into its ecosystem, avoiding much of the enormous infrastructure spending burden facing its rivals. Eric breaks down Apple's latest earnings, its massive share repurchase program, and why investors are increasingly rewarding the company's capital-efficient AI strategy. He also compares the Magnificent Seven's performance in 2026 against their remarkable returns since the beginning of 2023, revealing a very different picture of the AI investment boom. Has Apple become the market's ultimate AI safe-haven stock? And could its strategy continue outperforming NVIDIA and the rest of Big Tech?
news.title_zh: Apple 現為 2026 表現最佳的「宏偉 7」股票。為何能擊敗 NVIDIA、Tesla 與 Amazon

news.title: The Next Stock Market Crash Could Start With Just 3 Companies
news.summary: Just three companies now account for approximately 21% of the S&P 500's total market capitalization. NVIDIA (NVDA), Apple (AAPL), and Microsoft (MSFT) have become so dominant that their performance could determine the direction of the entire stock market. But what happens if these technology giants stumble? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St. co-founder Doug McIntyre and senior writer Lee Jackson discuss the extraordinary concentration of the S&P 500 and why millions of investors may be taking on more risk than they realize. Much of today's market enthusiasm is driven by artificial intelligence. Companies like NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet (GOOGL), Amazon (AMZN), and Meta Platforms (META) have benefited from enormous expectations for AI growth. But Doug and Lee identify several potential threats to that optimism. They explore how cheaper open-source AI models could challenge industry leaders, why opposition to AI data center construction threatens expansion plans, and how growing electricity demand is driving renewed interest in nuclear power. Most importantly, they discuss what could happen to popular index funds like the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) if the market's largest technology stocks suffer a major sell-off. They also examine whether equal-weight S&P 500 funds could provide investors with better diversification. Is your S&P 500 investment more vulnerable than you think?

news.summary_zh: 目前僅三家公司佔標普 500 總市值約 21%。輝達 (NVDA)、蘋果 (AAPL) 和微軟 (MSFT) 已變得如此主導，其表現可能決定整個股市走向。但若這些科技巨頭跌倒會怎樣？在這一集中，24/7 Wall St. 聯合創辦人 Doug McIntyre 和資深撰稿人 Lee Jackson 討論標普 500 的異常集中度，以及為何數百萬投資人可能承擔比預期更多風險。當前市場熱情很大程度由人工智慧驅動。輝達、微軟、Alphabet (GOOGL)、亞馬遜 (AMZN) 和 Meta Platforms (META) 等公司受惠於對 AI 成長的龐大預期。但 Doug 和 Lee 指出幾項對該樂觀情緒的潛在威脅。他們探討較便宜的開源 AI 模型如何挑戰業界領導者、為何反對 AI 資料中心建設威脅擴張計畫、以及不斷增長的電力需求如何推動核能重獲關注。最重要的是，他們討論若市場最大型科技股遭遇大規模拋售，熱門指數基金如 SPDR 標普 500 ETF (SPY) 會發生什麼情況。他們也檢視等權重標普 500 基金是否能為投資人提供更好分散化。您的標普 500 投資是否比您想像中更脆弱？

news.title: Intel vs. Qualcomm: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.summary: Intel's foundry turnaround has resulted in heavy losses and negative free cash flow, while Qualcomm generates robust cash with half the valuation multiple.

news.summary_zh: 該晶片製造商在以色列的廠區發生爆炸，讓投資人猶豫不決。

news.title: Is Intel's Record Sales Growth Still Improving?
news.summary: Intel Corporation (INTC) sold 25.4% more in the three months to June than it did in the same quarter a year earlier. The chipmaker has not grown faster in any quarter of the last ten years. To judge that record properly requires looking at what is normal for the company. So take a guess: in a typical quarter, how much more does Intel sell than a year earlier.
news.title_zh: Intel 破紀錄的營收成長仍在改善中嗎？
news.summary_zh: Intel Corporation (INTC) 在截至六月的三個月內，銷售額比去年同期多出 25.4%。這家晶片大廠在過去十年任何一季都未曾成長得更快。要正確評估該紀錄，需參考公司常態表現。所以猜猜看：在典型季度中，Intel 比一年前多賣多少。

news.title: 3 Reasons to Buy Intel Stock Before 2027
news.summary: After the stock nearly tripled over the past year, stronger execution and growing CPU demand could fuel further upside.
news.title_zh: 3 個在 2027 前買進 Intel 股票的理由
news.summary_zh: 股價在過去一年近乎翻三倍後，更強的執行力與成長的 CPU 需求可能推動進一步上漲。

news.title: Applied Materials vs. Intel: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.summary: Applied Materials earned a 24.7% net margin and generated nearly $5.7 billion in free cash flow in fiscal 2025, and Intel recorded a small net loss and negative free cash flow in 2025 as it works on a manufacturing turnaround.
news.title_zh: Applied Materials 對決 Intel：2026 哪檔科技股較值得買進？
news.summary_zh: Applied Materials 在 2025 財年達成 24.7% 淨利率，並產生近 $5.7 billion 自由現金流；而 Intel 在 2025 記錄小額淨虧損與負自由現金流，因其致力於製造轉型。

news.title: Qualcomm Vs. Intel: The Market is Refuting Both AI Rebrand Attempts
news.summary: Intel and Qualcomm both showed up to earnings with a fresh AI identity, but investors have been voting with their feet ever since. One company is already cashing AI checks while the other is asking you to fund a roadmap that has yet to book its first dollar.
news.title_zh: 高通對決英特爾：市場正在否決雙方的AI重塑嘗試
news.summary_zh: 英特爾和高通都帶著全新的AI形象出席財報，但投資者此後一直在用腳投票。一家公司已經在兌現AI支票，而另一家則要求你為尚未錄得第一美元收入的路線圖買單。

news.title: Martin Shkreli Says New Photonic Chips Could Run Circles Around Nvidia
news.summary: Martin Shkreli just named three private startups he believes could threaten Nvidia's dominance in AI chips, and his reasoning involves a technology that computes at the speed of light. The catch is that Nvidia may already be one step ahead.
news.title_zh: Martin Shkreli 稱新型光子晶片可輕易超越 Nvidia
news.summary_zh: Martin Shkreli 剛點出三家他認為可能威脅 Nvidia 在 AI 晶片領域統治地位的私人新創公司，他的理由涉及一種以光速運算的技術。問題在於 Nvidia 可能已經領先一步。

news.title: Broadcom Falls 4% as CEO Hock Tan’s Capital Warning Hangs Over AI Chips; Marvell Drops 4%
news.summary: Broadcom's own CEO just flagged a threat that has nothing to do with chip supply, and it is hitting custom AI chip stocks far harder than the broader semiconductor market.
news.title_zh: Broadcom 下跌 4% 因 CEO Hock Tan 的資本警告籠罩 AI 晶片；Marvell 下跌 4%
news.summary_zh: Broadcom 自身的 CEO 剛標示了一個與晶片供應無關的威脅，且它對客製化 AI 晶片股的衝擊遠大於更廣泛的半導體市場。

news.title: Should You Buy The Dip In Marvell Stock?
news.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock closed at $245.28 on October 14, 2026, down 14.5% from its October 6 close. That close came the day the shares rallied after the chip designer raised its long-term sales outlook on growing data-center demand. For investors who missed the initial rally, the lower price can look like a second chance. Should you take it.
news.title_zh: 您應該在 Marvell 股票下跌時買入嗎？
news.summary_zh: Marvell Technology (MRVL) 股價於 October 14, 2026 收盤價為 $245.28，較其 October 6 收盤價下跌 14.5%。該收盤價出現在晶片設計師因資料中心需求增長而上調長期銷售展望、股價反彈的當天。對於錯過初期反彈的投資人來說，較低的價格可能看起來像第二次機會。您應該把握嗎？

news.title: Can Marvell Stock Drop From Here?
news.summary: Over the past twelve months, Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock has returned 216%, easily outpacing a roughly 18% return for the S&P 500. On October 6, management set a fiscal 2031 revenue target of $70 billion to $90 billion, and the shares closed up about 6% that day. Yet that target remains a forecast rather than a result. Today's buyers carry the risk if Marvell falls short. So what are you paying for Marvell's growth today.
news.title_zh: Marvell 股價還會下跌嗎？
news.summary_zh: 過去十二個月，Marvell Technology (MRVL) 股票回報了 216%，輕鬆超越標普 500 大約 18% 的回報。在 October 6，管理層設定了財政 2031 營收目標 $70 billion to $90 billion，當天股價收盤上漲約 6%。然而該目標仍屬預測而非結果。今日買方承擔 Marvell 若表現不及預期的風險。那麼你今天為 Marvell 的成長支付了什麼代價。

news.title: Price Prediction: This Stock Could Double by 2027
news.summary: Credo Technology just posted triple-digit revenue growth for the eighth quarter in a row, yet the stock sits more than 30% below its 52-week high. Whether that gap is a buying opportunity or a warning sign depends on two product lines that have not shipped at scale yet.
news.title_zh: 價格預測：這檔股票可能在 2027 翻倍
news.summary_zh: Credo Technology 剛連續第八季公布三位數營收成長，但股價仍較其 52 週高點低逾 30%。這個缺口是買入機會還是警訊，取決於兩條尚未大規模出貨的產品線。

news.summary: Marvell just secured a deal its CEO called a monster number, analysts have zero sell ratings on the stock, and the biggest growth catalyst has barely shown up in the financials yet.
